name: Fair Game
description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret and the trophy unlocks [1]. The questline marks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, is Jason-only, and runs through Bret's Target Decks, with 15 decks feeding the 100% checklist [1][2]. PowerPyx notes the exact animal that triggers the trophy is still being confirmed [1].
steps: As Jason, answer Bret's text after Chapter 2's Coffee Break [1].
Meet Bret in Veteran Hunted and collect the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle [1][2].
Work his Target Deck hunts until the unique animal falls [1].
The trophy pops with the unique kill [1][3].
window: PowerPyx reports the questline stays available after the story, so the risk window is only skipping the Jason-only message entirely [1]; our data flags it one-chance, so take Bret's first hunt as soon as the Veteran Hunted marker appears [1][2].

a.text: PowerPyx roadmap: which animal exactly unlocks this is still undergoing confirmation.

b.text: PowerPyx walkthrough: Bret's strand runs 15 Target Decks and the trophy should come naturally along the way.

dispute.call: Treat Bret's full Target Deck chain as the safe path; the trophy pops somewhere along his hunting decks.

name: Don't Touch My Deck
guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. The game holds 18 sets with 480 unique cards, so you can pick the three easiest themes [1][2]. The 100% checklist asks for 15 complete sets, which will swallow this trophy along the way [1][2].
steps: Pick three small sets from the 18 and mark their locations on the map [2].
Collect every card in those three sets, using the binder to see what is missing [1][2].
The trophy pops when the third set completes [1][3].

name: You WAiNKer!
guide: WAiNK-scan 100 objects and the trophy unlocks [1]. The scan sets are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags, with more than 100 total so any 100 will do [1][2]. Each scan is a hold-and-scan moment, and the progress database tracks them all [1].
steps: Hold the WAiNK app and scan every landmark you pass [1][2].
Work the landmark and curiosity sets first, since they are the best mapped [1][2].
Keep scanning sculptures and tags until the counter hits 100 [1].
The trophy pops on the 100th scan [1][3].

name: One Last Thing
guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. The eight categories hold ten challenges each, so you can skip the thirty hardest [1][2]. Working toward the 70 needed for the 100% checklist will bank this trophy automatically [1].
steps: Open Progress > Challenges and tick the Completed checkmarks [1][2].
Knock out the easy tiers in each category first [1].
Keep the trophy for late, since other trophies will complete many challenges passively [1].
The trophy pops on the 50th completion [1][3].

name: Hot Together
description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and the trophy unlocks [1]. It becomes possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when both characters can free-roam together [1][2]. The cleanest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the helicopter cannot see you [1].
steps: Finish Coffee Break to unlock partner free-roam, then call your partner to ride along [1][2].
Cause carnage until the wanted level hits 4 stars [1].
Ride through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia and stay until the red heat zone clears [1].
The trophy pops when the wanted level fully clears [1][3].

citations.snippet: Earliest after Chapter 2's Coffee Break; escape a 4-star wanted level together; drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County; pops after leaving the red heat zone.

name: Retail Therapy
description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while the wanted level never drops, and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. It opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when both characters can work together [1]. The pop is delayed - it lands about half a minute after you leave the third shop [1][2].
steps: Finish Coffee Break, then equip an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation [1][2].
Call your partner and hit 3 robbery targets in a row, looting a couple of items per store [2].
Break the back-room safe with sticky bombs on the third store, then drive off [2].
The trophy pops shortly after leaving the third shop [1][3].

citations.snippet: Rob 3 robbery targets while chased the whole time; pops half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop; the 3 Jewelry Stores in north Vice City work well.

name: Whip It Good
guide: Discover 100 vehicles and the trophy unlocks [1]. Scanning with the WAiNK app is enough - stand at a busy road and scan the traffic until the counter climbs [1]. The game ships 557 vehicles, and the 200 base-model scans the 100% checklist wants will carry you past 100 [1][2].
steps: Hold the WAiNK app and scan every new vehicle you see [1].
Sweep busy roads, then marinas and airfields for boats and aircraft [1].
Track found totals under Progress > Vehicles [1][2].
The trophy pops on the 100th discovery [1][3].

name: Gunslinger
description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus and the trophy unlocks [1]. Trigger focus while aiming, buffed by food and an Adrenaline item, and line up five gang members so no shot is wasted [1]. The trophy does not register on police, soldiers or civilians [1].
steps: Buff focus with food or a shower, and hold Adrenaline ready [1].
Wear body armor and bring the Duke 556 rifle [1][3].
Walk into a gang operation and activate Combat Focus while aiming [1][2].
Drop 5 gang members before the purple bar empties; the trophy pops on the fifth [1].

name: Catch Me If You Can
description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
guide: Steal a passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA and fly it out to unlock the trophy [1][2]. The plane must be one connected to a boarding bridge - the airfield planes do not count - and the E3/E4 gates are the easiest [1][2]. The unlock is delayed until you fly roughly 1km from the airport [1][2].
steps: Drive through the fence and head for the plane at departure terminal E3/E4 [1][2].
Board via the stairs beside the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit [2].
Drive the plane backward to the runway, take off and fly 1km away [1][2].
The trophy pops once you are far enough from VCIA [1][3].

citations.snippet: Steal a passenger plane docked at a departure terminal - terminal E3/E4 is easiest; fly 1km from the airport to pop.

guide: Steal a military tank and the trophy unlocks [1]. The tanks sit at Mile Zero Air Station, the island base in the south-west of Mariana County [1][2]. Drive through the gate, climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy fires [1].
steps: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station in the south-west of the map [1][2].
Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump beside the south-east entrance [1].
Enter a tank and fire on enemies until the trophy pops [1][3].

name: Sneakthief
description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: Rob a jewelry store undetected and the trophy unlocks [1]. Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first, since that mission hands over the Snap Gun for silent lockpicking [1][2]. A clean run means the back door, the safe code note, the safe itself, then destroying the security footage and disabling the alarm before leaving [1].
steps: Play Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun [1][2].
Pick a marked jewelry store, such as Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds, and enter through the back door with the Snap Gun [1].
Read the safe code note, loot the safe, then destroy the security footage and disable the alarm [1].
Leave the store; the trophy pops shortly after [1][3].

name: Maximum Withdrawal
guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, and the trophy unlocks [1]. The big vault jobs open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which teaches the security-van tail [1][3]. The 100% checklist wants all 8 large vaults, so the trophy banks itself along the way [1][2].
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe) [1][3].
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 to mark the vans [1].
Tail a van to its bank, rob the open vault and escape the 4-star heat on a fast bike [1].
Repeat at 5 different large vaults; the trophy pops after the fifth escape [1][2].

name: A Classic Blitz Play
description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
guide: Rob an armored truck and escape, and the trophy unlocks [1]. The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is banks it automatically, because robbing a large bank vault counts as the armored-truck job [1][2]. For an early grab, sticky-bomb the back door of a truck cruising near the banks [1].
steps: Either play That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4 and rob the vault [1][2].
Or, early: block an armored truck near a bank and blow its back door with a sticky bomb [1].
Grab the cash and escape the red heat radius or hit a Pay 'n' Spray [1].
The trophy pops after the escape [1][3].

citations.snippet: Auto-unlocks during Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is; robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck; earlier method: sticky bomb the back door near banks.

name: The Goodtime State
guide: Explore all of Leonida by unfogging the entire map, and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. The fastest route is a plane, flying passes over every black-fog region until the map is fully visible [1][2]. Every discovered region stays revealed for good [2].
steps: Steal or buy a fast plane once the map opens up [2].
Fly grid passes over the fogged regions, including the coast and lake country [1][2].
Open the map to confirm no black fog remains [1].
The trophy pops when the last region clears [1][3].
